market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check 2y/10y Treasury yields and Fed funds futures (SOFR/SR3) for corroborating dovish repricing; confirm move is not idiosyncratic to the market.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs implied-vol / MOVE index; look for a news catalyst (Fed speak, labor/inflation surprise) that already explains it.
time_plan.2h: Re-check whether the probability shift persists or reverts; watch equity reaction to distinguish 'good easing' vs 'recession fear'.
time_plan.6h: Assess whether curve steepening/bull-flattening is consistent with an easing narrative; note any Fed communication.
time_plan.12h: Mark TLT close vs entry; evaluate if the prediction-market move led or lagged the rates move.

predictions.reasoning: An 8-cut (200bps) scenario for 2026 is a deep-easing tail that implies either a severe recession or emergency intra-meeting cuts. A sharp rise in the implied probability of that many cuts would front-run a large downward repricing of the Fed path, pulling front-end and long-end yields lower and lifting duration-sensitive bond prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid duration proxy.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EURUSD for confirmation; verify move aligns with lower US front-end yields rather than a global risk-off dollar bid.
time_plan.1h: Distinguish rate-differential weakness from safe-haven flows by watching risk assets and JPY/CHF.
time_plan.2h: Re-check persistence and whether other central-bank expectations shifted simultaneously.
time_plan.6h: Reassess dollar vs gold to gauge whether easing or risk-off dominates.
time_plan.12h: Mark UUP close vs entry; note if FX confirmed or contradicted the rates signal.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in the probability of aggressive Fed easing (8 cuts) narrows expected US rate differentials versus other central banks, which is typically dollar-negative. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. Effect is weaker/noisier than the rates channel because a US recession can also trigger safe-haven dollar demand, muting or reversing the move.

evidence_used: Market question implies a very dovish 8-cut (200bps) Fed path for 2026, including emergency cuts
Standard macro transmission: lower expected policy rates lift bond prices and pressure the dollar
TLT and UUP are highly liquid proxies for duration and the dollar
uncertainty_notes: 8 cuts is a low-probability tail; small probability moves may carry limited information
A recession-driven easing narrative can produce a safe-haven dollar bid, offsetting the rate-differential channel
The 700bp tradable threshold is far above realistic 12h moves in these instruments, so neither prediction is 'tradable' by that bar
Prediction-market pricing on distant 2026 outcomes is thin and may be noise rather than leaked information

llm_justification.summary: A market pricing 8 Fed cuts in 2026 is a deep-easing/recession tail. If its implied probability spiked, the cleanest downstream implications are lower Treasury yields (TLT up) and a weaker dollar (UUP down) via rate-differential compression. Both mappings are directionally sound but modest in 12h magnitude, well below the 700bp tradable threshold, and the dollar leg is ambiguous due to potential safe-haven offset. Treat as low-to-moderate confidence research signal.
key_assumptions: A rise in the 8-cut probability reflects genuine dovish repricing, not resolution mechanics or thin-market noise
Rate expectations transmit normally to bond prices and FX within the 12h window
No dominant offsetting global risk-off flow
failure_modes: Move already public/priced from a prior macro release, so no incremental asset move
Recession fear triggers safe-haven USD strength, reversing the UUP-down thesis
Equity reaction dominates and drags TLT via cross-asset flows rather than pure rate signal
Prediction-market shift is illiquid noise with no real information content
12h magnitudes far below the 700bp tradable bar, making any signal economically marginal
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
